title: Preheat oven and prep wedges
description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cut sweet potatoes (1.3 lb, about 2 medium) into large wedges, then toss with olive oil (1.5 tbsp), smoked paprika (0.5 tsp), and kosher salt (0.5 tsp) on a sheet pan.

title: Roast wedges on first side
description: Spread sweet potato wedges in a single layer with one cut side down and roast until the first side is deeply browned.

title: Flip and finish roasting wedges
description: Flip each sweet potato wedge to the other cut side and roast until deeply caramelized and tender when pierced with a knife.

title: Season and rest beef
description: Pat beef tenderloin (12 oz) very dry, toss with ground cumin (0.5 tsp), kosher salt (0.5 tsp), and black pepper to taste, then rest at room temperature.

title: Mix aji amarillo sauce
description: Whisk aji amarillo paste (1 tbsp), soy sauce (2 tbsp), red wine vinegar (1.5 tbsp), and oyster sauce (1 tsp, optional) in a small bowl and keep it near the stove.

title: Sear beef
description: Heat a large skillet or wok until smoking, add half of the neutral oil (1 tbsp), and sear beef tenderloin in a single layer. Transfer beef to a plate.

title: Stir-fry onion and garlic
description: Return the pan to high heat, add remaining neutral oil (1 tbsp), stir-fry red onion wedges (1 cup) until softened at the edges, then add minced garlic (3 cloves).

title: Add tomatoes and sauce
description: Add Roma tomato wedges (2 tomatoes) and toss until warmed through. Pour in the aji amarillo sauce and reduce briefly while scraping up browned bits.

title: Combine and finish lomo
description: Return beef tenderloin and resting juices to the pan, toss just long enough to coat and warm through, then remove from heat.

title: Plate and serve
description: Divide sweet potato wedges across plates, spoon lomo saltado alongside, and serve with lime wedges (1 lime).
